values.note: Single site $10; paid at the entrance fee tube or by Scan & Pay at the kiosk. Senior and Access Pass holders pay half.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/hankinson-hills-campground ('Single Site: $10 per night'; 'Via the Fee Tube with fee envelopes'; 'The Senior Pass and the Access Pass holders receive a 50% discount'); rec.gov rates 2026 and 2027 ($10 for every walk-in site type), read 2026-11-12

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10369364 ('There are no electric or water hookups at any location. There is no RV dump station'); catalog: all 16 records NONELECTRIC, water/sewer No, read 2026-11-12

values.note: Non-equestrian loop: sites 1-9 (gravel; 4 and 5 are 60-ft RV pull-throughs, 6 and 7 are 30 ft, the rest 40-60 ft). Equestrian loop: sites 10-15 (30-60 ft, three pull-throughs); campers without horses may use it when 1-9 are full.

sites.source: recreation.gov catalog 10369364 (01-09 STANDARD/RV NONELECTRIC, Max Vehicle Length 30-60, 04/05 Pull-through; 10-15 EQUESTRIAN NONELECTRIC 30-60); campground notice ('CAMPERS WITHOUT HORSES—Please select a campsite in the Non-Equestrian Loop (campsites #1 to #9). If all such sites are occupied when you arrive, you may select an unoccupied site in the Equestrian Loop'), read 2026-11-12

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10369364 ('Three vault toilets and two potable water hand-pumps are available'; 'There is no RV dump station'); FS page ('three vault toilets, a large picnic shelter, and a hand pump with potable water'), read 2026-11-12

values.note: No reservations; pay on site. The site must be occupied the first night and not left unattended over 24 hours; 28 nights a year.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/hankinson-hills-campground ('No reservations. All sites are on a first-come, first-served basis.'; 'Stay limit of 14 consecutive days'); rec.gov rules (reservationCutOff 'Not Reservable'; maxConsecutiveStay 14; maxStay 28 nights each year; notice 'Campsite must be occupied the first night and may not be left unattended for more than 24 hours'), read 2026-11-12

values.note: Limited services after Labor Day and before Memorial Day.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/hankinson-hills-campground ('Open year-round. Limited services after Labor Day and before Memorial Day.'; 'Seasons of Use: Year-round'), read 2026-11-12

note: USFS campground in the Hankinson Hills area of the Sheyenne National Grassland: oak woods and grassed sand dunes. Two loops, one for campers with horses; large picnic shelter. Pack in, pack out. Connects to the 8-mile non-motorized Hankinson Hills Trail. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov confirm $10, no hookups or dump, vault toilets and hand-pump water, 15 gravel sites (1-9 non-equestrian incl. two 60-ft RV pull-throughs; 10-15 equestrian), FCFS only (not reservable), 14 consecutive / 28 a year, open year-round. Booking reservable true -> false; note's 'Reservable online' removed. Not waterfront stands.
